hypothesis: On LinkedIn, a problem-led post built on a worked example (variant B) earns more link clicks and Gumroad product views per impression than the product-description post (variant A) for the Freelance Project Profitability Tracker (B16-007, $12).
baseline: Variant A: generated listing copy, job SJ-72586ec7a01c, utm_content=b16-007-linkedin-v1. Today: 0 recorded views, 0 sales for B16-007 (live since 2026-10-29).
change: Variant B: problem-led post with the product's illustrative example, utm_content=b16-007-linkedin-v2. Only the framing changes; product, price, channel, account and posting slot stay the same.
metric: Primary: link clicks per 1,000 LinkedIn impressions per variant (founder reads LinkedIn post analytics). Secondary: Gumroad product views and sales whose referrer carries the variant's utm_content. Decision only at >= 30 link clicks per variant (engine floor); below that the result is INSUFFICIENT DATA.
